package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for order_by_without_limit_orm_chain: ORM chains that order results without a Limit on request paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

type Comment struct {
	ID        int
	PostID    int
	Body      string
	CreatedAt string
}

func ListComments(db *gorm.DB, postID int) ([]Comment, error) {
	var comments []Comment
	err := db.Where("post_id = ?", postID).
		Order("created_at desc").
		Find(&comments).Error
	return comments, err
}
